claims: Thursday/Friday coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on ESPN.
Weekend rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament are on CBS.
"Masters Live" provides free streaming of featured groups and Amen Corner.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is Thursday, April 9 from 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is Friday, April 10 from 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is Saturday, April 11 from 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is Sunday, April 12 from 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Masters.com and the Masters app provide free comprehensive coverage including featured groups, Amen Corner (holes 11, 12, 13), and holes 4, 5, and 6.
Paramount+ simulcasts CBS coverage and offers exclusive early round coverage.
ESPN+ and ESPN app stream featured groups and holes.
Prime Video carries early-round coverage on Thursday and Friday.
Amen Corner consists of holes 11, 12, and 13.
